# S H Health Centre

Holistic health clinic in Kalyan Nagar, Bengaluru (HRBR 2nd Block), offering acupuncture, acupressure, Siddha-informed consultations, and pain support. MedicalClinic JSON-LD and contact details appear on the live site.

## Canonical entry points

- Home: https://shhealthcentre.com/
- Services hub: https://shhealthcentre.com/services
- About: https://shhealthcentre.com/about
- Contact / booking: https://shhealthcentre.com/contact
- Blog: https://shhealthcentre.com/blog
